data.body: **[P2] Restore logger enrichment when a rejected instance is later accepted.** Rejection removes the constructor-installed filter, but a subsequent successful registration of the same explicit instance (or provider singleton) only flips this flag. Startup logs then remain uncorrelated until `on_invocation_start`, and the filter never returns if that hook exits early. Reinstall the filter in the accepted branch when enrichment is enabled, mirror the fix in `ExecutionOtelPlugin`, and test a `False` → `True` same-instance transition.
